# heytownhall_usage (Data Source)

A month's live usage and the bill to date. Counts reach the database every few minutes, so the newest requests may be missing; `counted_through` says how far the count goes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The current month.
data "heytownhall_usage" "now" {}

# A past month.
data "heytownhall_usage" "october" {
  month = "2026-10"
}

output "bill_to_date_dollars" {
  value = data.heytownhall_usage.now.total_cents / 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `month` (String) The month as `YYYY-MM`, in Vancouver time. Defaults to the current month.

### Read-Only

- `counted_through` (String) The time up to which requests are counted (RFC 3339).
- `lines` (Attributes List) The bill by meter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lines))
- `projected_cents` (Number) The bill at this month's pace, to its last day. Null before any live request.
- `requests` (Number) Billed live requests so far.
- `sandbox_requests` (Number) Sandbox requests so far. They are not billed.
- `spend_cap_cents` (Number) The spending cap in US cents, or null for no cap.
- `total_cents` (Number) The bill to date in US cents.

<a id="nestedatt--lines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lines`

Read-Only:

- `cents` (Number) The line's amount in US cents.
- `description` (String) What the line bills.
- `meter` (String) The meter's name.
- `requests` (Number) Requests on this meter.
